units: millimetres; normalized desktop model, not measured architectural scale
palette_policy: Approximate daylight material families; no measured RGB or photographed textures; night amber is not daytime wall pigment.
scope: One complete freestanding Puli Paper Dome hall, approximate completed 2008–2009 Taiwan reconstruction; not Kobe site, entire park, current condition or as-built survey.
dimension_policy: Normalized authored ratios from historical Kobe plan/section and Taiwan photographs. Documented numbered frame transfer supports major topology, not replacement cladding/floor or exact hidden connections.
